_about: Every way the maps differ between website, iPhone and Android, and what is owed. scripts/mapparity.py refuses a push that changes one platform's map without touching this file; qa check_map_parity_ledger() holds its shape. status: open (a platform owes the change), one-sided (different on purpose, with why), done. Hidde, 2026-11-20: "niet alles moet hetzelfde maar als het kan wel".

rows.what: The locate arrow, faded out under a high sheet or a tree card, takes no tap
rows.web: to check: whether the explore and city maps' locate control can be tapped while a sheet covers it
rows.ios: TreeMap.swift: view.isUserInteractionEnabled = place.alpha > 0.05
rows.android: MapTab.kt: the controls leave the tree once recentrePlacement's alpha is 0.01 or less (ButtonWalk map-full, map-pin)
rows.owed: web: check the locate control under a covering sheet

rows.what: A chosen tree's card dragged down closes back to the list and the tab bar stays
rows.web: no tab bar on the website, so nothing steps away; the web sheet's card closes with its cross or a tap on the map
rows.ios: PinSelection in TreePlaceSheet.swift: peek or bar with a tree chosen lets it go, bar becomes peek; MapTab mapTakesScreen only with no tree (TreeCardDragWalk)
rows.android: MapTab.kt LaunchedEffect(sheet.height): BAR with a tree chosen lets it go and settles on PEEK
rows.why: the tab bar this guards exists only in the apps

rows.what: A filter that hides the chosen tree closes its card; a My trees lane switch frames that lane's trees; the location-off chip shortens at large text
rows.web: to check: the explore map's filter chips and the profile map's lanes do the same (map-card-js.ts, tree-pins-js.ts)
rows.ios: MapTab .onChange(of: filters) with MapFilters.keepsCard; CollectView.laneRegion through TreeMap.moveTo; whereChip ViewThatFits (WalkFindingsTests)
rows.android: MapTab.kt LaunchedEffect(filters) closes the card when MapFilters.keeps says no; MyTrees.kt laneBox through moveTo on a lane switch; LocationOffChip FitsOrElse, clear of the locate arrow (WalkFindingsTest, 2026-11-26)
rows.owed: web: check the explore filter chips and profile lanes

rows.what: The trees come back on the map after a light/dark switch while it is open
rows.web: nothing to fix: the website map does not swap its style when the phone changes theme
rows.ios: TreeMap.DrawnTrees.forget() on a style reload clears everything that decides a redraw (MapStyleReloadTests); before, the pins stayed away until a pan
rows.android: nothing to fix: TreeMapView.kt sets the tree layers in every setStyle callback and keeps no drawn memo across it
rows.why: a bug in the iPhone's own redraw memo; the other platforms never had that memo

rows.what: A tapped pin's card lets go with a short swipe down: 56 of drag or a 125/s flick (Material 3's sheet thresholds)
rows.web: on a phone the card floats over the map (Airbnb's mobile site) and a tap on the map lets it go; it has no sheet to swipe
rows.ios: BottomSheet.swift onEnded, from the card stop; the numbers in CardSwipe (CardSwipeTests, 2026-11-26)
rows.android: MapSheet.kt settle, from the card stop; the numbers in CardSwipe.kt (CardSwipeTest, 2026-11-26)
rows.why: the phones hold the tree in their sheet, the web's phone map uses Airbnb's floating card (CONVENTIONS.md "Tapping a pin on a map that has a list in a sheet"), so there is no swipe to tune

rows.what: The map itself: zoom buttons, one locate button, the place kept in the address, the trees, the card, the list that lights a pin
rows.web: one component, atTreeMap (tree-map-js.ts), on the city map, /explore, the country and state maps and the profile map; the fullscreen button (city map only) and the city map's own locate button are gone; the state pages' map stays an embedded box (no scroll zoom, no locate)
rows.ios: one map, TreeMap.swift, on every map screen
rows.android: one map, TreeMapView.kt, as iOS
rows.why: the same map on each platform; the controls follow the platform (MapLibre's buttons on the web, the app's own recentre button over the sheet, CONVENTIONS.md "A my-location control over a bottom sheet")

rows.what: The profile map follows the tab: Collected shows the trees you collected (and your own), Want to visit the trees you saved

rows.android: MyTrees.kt TreeMapView follows `lane`, as iOS; frame made once
rows.decided: Hidde, 2026-11-20: "bouw dit overal" (before: the web showed both lanes at once, the apps only Collected)

rows.android: TreeMapView onLongPress on the Map tab: MapLibre's red marker, the card in the sheet, back takes it away

rows.what: No crash when a tree pin layer's name is drawn twice (build 41 crash, 2026-11-20)
rows.web: nothing to change: maplibre-gl adds its tree layers once per map and updates the source in place
rows.ios: TreeMap.swift swaps a new source and new layers on every redraw; names carry the style state's seq (MapLayers.layerID) and every tree layer goes through addFresh
rows.android: nothing to change: TreeMapView.kt installLayers adds fixed-name layers once per style and updates the one source with setGeoJson
rows.why: only the iPhone renames its layers on every redraw, so only it could meet a name twice

rows.what: No error when a tapped pin's card closes while it opens on a phone-width web map (web_errors, 2026-11-25)
rows.web: map-card-js.ts reads the card's position for the phone ease only while the card is still up
rows.ios: nothing to change: the card is a SwiftUI view, never read after it is gone
rows.android: nothing to change: the card is a Compose view, never read after it is gone
rows.why: a script reading a removed DOM element is a web-only fault; the card behaves the same everywhere

rows.what: A desktop web map with no room beside, above or below a pin moves the pin aside so its card never covers it (2026-11-26, the California state map's walk)
rows.web: map-card-js.ts place(): when no side fits, panBy sideways (pin to 40 px from the left) or down below the card, then places again
rows.ios: nothing to change: the phone card stands at the bottom and the map eases the pin above it
rows.android: nothing to change: same bottom card as iOS
rows.why: only a desktop web map puts the card beside the pin; the phones already move the map to keep the pin clear

rows.what: Your own trees' photo pins are added to the map on the main thread
rows.web: nothing to do: MapLibre GL JS runs in the page's one thread
rows.ios: nothing to do: MapKit annotations are set from the main actor (TreeMap.swift)
rows.android: TreeMapView.kt: style.addImage for your photo pins in Dispatchers.Main.immediate (SignedInRoundTrip)
rows.why: A thread rule of MapLibre Native on Android; the other platforms have no worker thread on this path.

rows.android: nothing to change: Compose has no such limit and the map behaves the same
rows.why: a Swift compiler limit, not map behaviour
